doc_title: TRANSFER BY PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE TO PERSON ENTITLED UNDER A WILL OR ON AN INTESTACY
doc_title_official: TRANSFER BY PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE TO PERSON ENTITLED UNDER A WILL OR ON AN INTESTACY
when_used: A personal representative transfers the deceased proprietor's interest to the beneficiary entitled to it under the will or on an intestacy.

detail_rows.label: Date of Grant of Will/Letters of Administration
Transferor as Personal Representative of the Estate of the Deceased
Transferee(s) as Person Entitled under the Estate of the Deceased

body_text.text: The Transferor(s) as Personal Representative(s) of the above noted Deceased HEREBY TRANSFER(S) the interest of the Deceased in the above Title.
The Transfer is subject to the following:
The provisions of The Land Registration Act, 2012 (No 3 of 2012) and The Land Act, 2012 (No 6 of 2012);
The interests noted in the Register of the Title.
The Transfer is also subject to the following additional provisions, if any:
The Transferee(s) declare that they shall hold the land as joint proprietors/as proprietors in common* in the following undivided shares:-
IN WITNESS the Transferor and the Transferee have signed this Transfer as a deed.

execution.verification_heading: Verification of execution pursuant to Section 45 of the Land Registration Act

foot_notes: Insert full name(s) registration number(s) registered office and address, as applicable.
Insert currency, amount and other consideration where applicable.
****The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”
